timothy-k-gaspar.text: Goal of zero encampments in CD3: 24-hour response teams offering shelter, mental health and addiction services, using legal tools to clear encampments if help is refused. Says "Los Angeles has spent billions on homelessness, and the crisis got worse."
Would cut underperforming homeless service providers from city contracts, add oversight of 100+ providers, and shift responsibility for housing, mental health and addiction treatment to the County.
Public safety plan: zero tolerance for quality-of-life crime (public drug use, vandalism, illegal dumping, illegal vending, street racing), more park rangers, and an LAPD Cadets program.
Advocates increased law enforcement funding and said he would have rejected the current city budget for insufficient law enforcement allocation.

Endorsed by IBEW Locals 18 and 40, ILWU Local 13, BizFed, VICA, Apartment Association of Greater Los Angeles and Southland Regional Association of Realtors.
